Future<void> save(Object? x) async {}

// CASE dart_apostrophe_in_raw_after_await expect=pass
Future<String> clean(List<String> names) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
    names[i] = names[i].replaceAll(r'\', '');
  }
  await save(names);
  return 'done';
}

// CASE dart_triple_after_await expect=pass
Future<String> note(List<String> names) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
    names[i] = '''it's ${names[i]}''';
  }
  await save(names);
  return 'done';
}

// CASE dart_end expect=pass
void end() {}
